title: Retain the Message: - Summarize: Write or Say the Main Idea in Your Own
description: To retain the message: - Summarize: Write or say the main idea in your own words. - Look for patterns: Identify recurring themes or key points. - Practice context recall: Remember when and why something was said, not just how. Example: After a meeting, jot down the core decisions and action points instead of trying to recall word-for-word what was said.
